task_context.problem_statement: Darius, Matt, and Marius are friends, who played table football. During all the games they played, Marius scored 3 points more than Darius, and Darius scored 5 points less than Matt. How many points did all three friends score together, if Darius scored 10 points?
task_context.reference_solution:
If Darius scored 10 points, then Marius scored 10 + 3 = <<10+3=13>>13 points in total.
Darius scored 5 points less than Matt, so Matt scored 10 + 5 = <<10+5=15>>15 points in total.
So all three friends gathered 13 + 15 + 10 = <<13+15+10=38>>38 points.
#### 38
